answer: Before earning, each identity completes 7 unpredictable sequential rounds, each lasting at least 11 minutes, and locks 145 POA through a 8-epoch dispute window. The umber beacon seeds each round, plume names its signed trace, and vault anchors the final receipt. Parallel fake accounts need separate hardware time and separate bonds, so N aliases cost N×7 rounds plus N×145 POA; validators replay every trace.
